set.body:
Objective

Close the program only after independent evidence proves semantics, numerics, resources, compatibility, documentation, and installed-package behavior.

Certification court

- Audit every requirement in the umbrella and child epics against current source and artifacts.
- Run contract, oracle, differential, metamorphic, randomized, adversarial, regression, storage, source-session, interruption, and compatibility tests.
- Compare every optimized route with the independent dense evaluator.
- Verify rank-one rejection, capability forgery failures, nonlinear noncommutation, basis rotation laws, direct-sum recomposition, and exact versus projected reconstruction.
- Re-run measured memory and performance baselines for scalar frames and requested multivariate edges.
- Build and install the source artifact into an isolated library; execute all public examples and the full introductory journey against the installed package.
- Render and inspect edited vignettes and documentation.
- Run the complete test suite and CRAN-like R CMD check with zero package-caused errors, warnings, or notes.
- Verify no Kronecker matrix, implicit all-searchlight graph, hidden learned fit, or unsupported covariance claim entered the implementation.
- Confirm scientific plan identities distinguish every semantic change and remain stable under execution-only changes.

Acceptance evidence

A requirement-by-requirement certification report identifies the exact command, fixture, artifact, and result proving each claim. Narrow focused tests are insufficient for closure. Environment-only limitations must be separated from product defects and the exact affected gate rerun after resolution.

Ownership boundary

This epic is an independent audit and low-risk remediation court. It must not weaken tests, capabilities, numerical tolerances, resource accounting, or public claims merely to obtain green output.

Completion

Close only after all preceding epics are closed, the installed artifact passes, documentation is rendered and reviewed, benchmarks are recorded, and the final local R CMD check is clean. Hosted or cross-platform evidence must be reported separately and cannot be inferred from local success.
set.title: Epic 10: Independently certify evidence pairing, measurement forms, and tomography
